title: ONT metagenomics pipeline parameters
description: Nanopore metagenomics: metaMDBG assembly, MAG recovery and AMR localisation (after ONT application note AN_1282)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the input data are and where results are written.

samplesheet.description: CSV with columns sample,run,reads. One row per sequencing run; rows sharing a sample ID are combined.
samplesheet.help_text: reads may be a POD5 directory (basecalled by the pipeline), an unaligned BAM from Dorado, or a FASTQ(.gz) file.

read_filtering_options.title: Read filtering options
read_filtering_options.description: Quality and length filters applied to each run before assembly (Samtools, as in the app note).

basecalling_options.title: Basecalling options
basecalling_options.description: Used only for runs given as POD5 directories. Requires a GPU and Dorado.

dorado_model.help_text: Default matches the app note: SUP v5.0.0 with 6mA and 4mC_5mC.

dorado_container.help_text: Pin a version tag for reproducible runs.

assembly_and_binning_options.title: Assembly and binning options
assembly_and_binning_options.description: Contig size thresholds and binner settings.

large_contig_size.description: Contigs at or above this length (bp) are assessed individually for single-contig HQ MAGs.

mag_quality_options.title: MAG quality options
mag_quality_options.description: CheckM2 completeness and contamination thresholds (percent), as defined in the app note.

sc_hq_linear_completeness.description: Minimum completeness for a linear single-contig HQ MAG.

sc_hq_circular_completeness.description: Minimum completeness for a circular single-contig HQ MAG (tiered 'closed').

hq_completeness.description: Minimum completeness for a binned HQ MAG.

hq_contamination.description: Maximum contamination for a binned HQ MAG.

mq_completeness.description: Minimum completeness for a binned MQ MAG.

mq_contamination.description: Maximum contamination for a binned MQ MAG.

reference_database_options.title: Reference database options
reference_database_options.description: Databases used by CheckM2, GTDB-Tk, viralVerify and AMRFinderPlus.

amrfinder_db.description: AMRFinderPlus database directory. Leave empty to use the installed default.
